publisher: Office of the Federal Register and U.S. Government Publishing Office, Electronic Code of Federal Regulations
title_or_table: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program, application processing, 7 CFR 273.2: the steps in reading order, each with the step that follows it
observation_period: Regulation as eCFR printed it, up to date as of November 9, 2026
geography: United States; states run SNAP within these rules
universe_or_base: A household’s path from application to benefits under the federal rule
vintage: eCFR, title 7 up to date as of November 9, 2026; checked against the 2025 annual edition on govinfo
qualification: The times are the regulation’s limits, not measured waits; states may move faster, and some miss the limits. The interview rule allows phone interviews and waivers under 273.2(e)(2).

path.description: main (every rule) or branch (some rules, or a way out)

path_words.description: who takes the step, in words: every application, or the branch with its condition

time_limit.description: the longest time the regulation allows, not a measured wait

next_step.description: the step that follows, named, in reading order (contract R3-6)

what_happens.description: what happens, the research lead’s plain summary of the provision

source_words.description: the provision’s own words where it sets a test or a time

printed_source_line: Source: Office of the Federal Register and U.S. Government Publishing Office, Electronic Code of Federal Regulations, 7 CFR 273.2, SNAP application processing, as in force November 9, 2026, United States. Retrieved November 12, 2026. Times are the regulation’s limits; each step’s next step named by Oath & Action.
derivation: The rows of govinfo-snap-application-steps in reading order: the main path by its order, then the branch. next_step names the main step that follows each step (the first also names the branch, with the condition the branch summary opens with); the last step of the path and of the branch says it ends. path_words puts the path column in words. No other value changes.
